name: pf-fix-fishing-starter-rod
about: fix-fishing-starter-rod against the built packages keys, town instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Every character starts with the Driftwood Rod and the higher rods cost more (2026-10-25, the user's item 4). A brand-new paladin: the `starts with the Driftwood Rod` log line, the status's rod and drawn slot, the character screen's rod tooltip; then the pirate's rod button (wcaption rod-btn: the pirate is not a ShopWindow, so the shop probe does not apply) names Sturdy 1000 g, Sea 5000 g, Captain's 25000 g in turn and each press takes that gold; then 'Finest rod already'.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:fishing\] a new character: starts with the Driftwood Rod
